verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents one first-party integration: you connect a GitHub repository to get PR reviews. Its own copy says it brings review into your tools 'starting with your GitHub pull requests', which implies other integrations are not yet available. The CLI, MCP and widget script tag are developer building blocks or Foreloop's own collection surface, not third-party tool connections. Missing for 10: integrations beyond GitHub, evidence that connecting takes only a few clicks, an integrations catalog for common PM tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect common third-party tools to my feedback workspace in just a few clicks

citations.quote: Connect a repository and get automatic product reviews on your pull requests.
Foreloop brings product context and review into the tools you already use, starting with your GitHub pull requests.
